quest.title: Old Tastes Die Hard
quest.description: Emerald Maple's Mr. Zhu is feeling nostalgic for an old delicacy. He's looking for someone to help bring that flavor back to him...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Recipe: Zhongyuan Chop Suey x1, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: All I remember is it was a sweet, fragrant dish. The sheer look of it was enough to get me drooling at the mouth... And to top it all off, it was nutritious too.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: The ingredients are a lot of Fowl and some Sweet Flowers. It's called... Sweetened Mistress or something like that. If you'd be able to make one for me, I'd be ever so grateful.

talks.objective: Give the "Sweetened Mistress" to Mr. Zhu

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Thank you ever so much! Please take this for your trouble, traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Aha! This is the one! Mmm, yes, that's the taste I remember!

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Now to see if I can recreate it...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Hmm... Doesn't taste or look much like the one I was thinking of...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Let me give you a quick recap...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Let me have a quick taste...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Just how am I going to recreate that flavor?
